name: perspective-text
title: Perspective Text
description: Words or lines stacked in depth on a plane that tilts towards the cursor. Sits at a calm fixed angle under reduced motion.

props.name: text
props.description: The text. Screen readers read it as one string.

props.name: split
props.description: Split into words, or into lines at each line break.

props.name: depth
props.description: Distance between neighbouring pieces along the depth axis, in pixels.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Perspective distance in pixels. Lower is more dramatic.

props.name: rotateY
props.description: Largest tilt around the vertical axis, in degrees.

props.name: rotateX
props.description: Largest tilt around the horizontal axis, in degrees.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Tilt towards the cursor while it is over the text. Off on touch screens and under reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
